# FinQA third-party data attribution

Source: https://github.com/czyssrs/FinQA
Immutable upstream commit: `0f16e2867befa6840783e58be38c9efb9229d742`
Public test Git blob: `59958c7c3bb3b21f4dff6bc912a0fe0ae710aee0`
License blob at that commit: `fb3b513238ba5ec7e0799cb1190ff30c759a5bdf` (MIT, copyright 2021 Zhiyu Chen).

SUTRA vendors only a 24-case deterministic public-test semantic subset plus the complete public-test ID/rank inventory. Selection is based only on case ID, not labels or results. The upstream README describes `test.json` as public test data with ground-truth references. No private-test references are used.
